rarity_score_formula.description: Sum of (1 / weight) for each trait. Lower weight = higher score. Common capy with rare traits can beat mythic with common traits.

art_guidelines.style: dark tech, no purple glow, clean lines, atmospheric
art_guidelines.base_pose: same across all 3 tiers — upright, three-quarter view, arms slightly away from body
art_guidelines.tinting_approach: one base art per trait, code handles environment color shifts
